job.title: CNC Machinists – Afternoon Shift
job.description:
Our client is a world-leading manufacturer specialising in high-precision components used in semiconductor manufacturing, scientific research, and advanced medical technology.
We are seeking experienced and self-motivated CNC Machinists to join their highly skilled manufacturing team. These opportunities are ideal for machinists who take pride in producing precision components to the highest standards and enjoy working with advanced CNC technology.
You will work on a variety of short-run, long-run and bespoke one-off jobs using sophisticated machinery, including dual-spindle multitasking machines and advanced 3-axis to simultaneous 5-axis milling machines.

Key Requirements
  • Recognised trade qualification in CNC Machining preferred.
  • Extensive experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of CNC machine setting, operation and production.
  • Experience with Mazatrol and GibbsCAM software is advantageous.
  • Ability to accurately read and interpret technical drawings and 3D models.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
  • Strong understanding of workplace health and safety practices.
  • Self-motivated, reliable and willing to learn and develop new skills.

What's on Offer?
  • Competitive hourly rate based on experience.
  • Overtime paid at time and a half.
  • Afternoon shift available Start 2.45pm – 12.30am Monday to Thursday. Must be available for 4 weeks of Training on the dayshift
  • Overtime available across Friday, Saturday and Sunday as required
  • Ongoing training and development opportunities.
  • On-site gym and café facilities.

Apply Today!
This is an excellent opportunity to join an established, innovative manufacturing operation where precision, quality and continuous improvement are at the forefront.
If you are an experienced CNC Machinist looking for your next career move, we would love to hear from you.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in New Zealand.
Apply now with your CV and details of your CNC machining experience to margaret@dynamixrecruitment.co.nz

job.title: ELECTRONICS ASSEMBLERS – PUT YOUR SKILLS TO WORK!
job.description:
Are you an electronics whiz who loves working with your hands, bringing technology to life and seeing the results of a job well done?

  • Building and assembling PCB boards.
  • Wiring and soldering electronic components.
  • Reading and following electrical and electronic diagrams.
  • Quality checking finished products.
  • Using hand tools to complete accurate, high-quality assembly work.

What skills will you bring?
We're looking for people who have:
  • Previous electronic or electrical assembly experience.
  • Soldering and wiring experience.
  • Experience wiring electrical panels.
  • The ability to read and understand electrical/electronic diagrams.
  • Confidence using hand tools and working with small components.
  • A keen eye for detail and a passion for quality.

Most importantly, you'll bring a positive attitude, a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

What's in it for you?
  • Monday to Thursday – enjoy 3 day weekends!
  • Free onsite parking.
  • Get paid weekly.
  • Ongoing support and training.
  • Opportunities to develop your skills and progress your career.
  • Great onsite lunchroom overlooking the golf course!

Available Shifts
  • Nightshift: 10:00pm – 08:00am Monday to Thursday
  • Training for 4 weeks on dayshift Monday to Friday 08:00am to 04:30pm

Employment types: Casual, Temporary and Long-Term opportunities available.

job.title: Quality Control Technician
job.description:
Passionate about quality? Let’s make a difference together!
Dynamix Recruitment is excited to be partnering with a well-established global manufacturing organisation seeking a motivated Quality Control Technician to join their team.
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys hands-on laboratory testing, problem-solving and continuous improvement. You’ll play a key role in ensuring products meet quality standards while working closely with production, technical and management teams.

What you’ll be doing
  • Conduct routine laboratory testing to ensure finished products meet quality specifications.
  • Complete quality checks and calibration activities in line with established procedures.
  • Maintain ISO 9001 compliance and ensure quality documentation is accurate and up to date.
  • Assist with technical enquiries, customer complaints, formulation optimisation and product reworking.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and help implement practical solutions.
  • Work collaboratively with production teams to maintain quality, safety and compliance standards.

What we’re looking for
  • Extensive experience in a production environment or a relevant tertiary qualification.
  • Knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; ISO 14001 knowledge is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail, organisational and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to build positive working relationships.
  • A proactive attitude, with the confidence to promote quality standards and drive improvements.
  • Basic Microsoft Office skills.

Why join?
This is an opportunity to become part of an established manufacturing operation where quality, teamwork and continuous improvement are valued. You’ll have the chance to contribute your ideas, develop your skills and make a meaningful impact on product quality and customer satisfaction.
Ready to take the next step in your career?

If you’re passionate about quality and enjoy making things better, we’d love to hear from you! Apply today through Dynamix Recruitment by sending your CV to margaret@dynamixrecruitment.co.nz
